scope: T0 run package 20261014T101305Z_026e6533 (seven artifacts): authority canonical re-pin proposal, protocol proposal, owner decision packet, receipt, summary, events, artifacts manifest. Independent read-only recomputation on the GB10 authoritative tree. Judgement is only whether the package may be presented to the owner for the protocol freeze signature. No acceptance of any task, no protocol freeze, no authority_map application, no registry/state write, no T1.
justification: Every load-bearing claim reproduces independently. Artifact manifest: 6/6 sha256+bytes exact, correctly self-excluded, run dir exactly 7 files. Input bindings: 7/7 exist and match. Authority re-pin: 13/13 canonical_blob_id equal git rev-parse HEAD:<path>; 13/13 gb10_worktree_raw_sha256 equal this machine's measured bytes; 13/13 local_worktree_raw_sha256 equal the authority_map pin and are exactly reproducible; classifications recompute to {pin_matches_worktrees:7, eol_representation_uniform_crlf:3, eol_representation_mixed:3} with derived unexplained 0. The six mismatches are proven, not asserted: each pin is reconstructed byte-exactly from its repository blob as an EOL-only variant (REPO_RULES/SKILL_ROUTING/SKILL_REGISTRY uniform CRLF; THREADS 653 CRLF + bare LF lines 1-2; DECISIONS single CRLF at the final line; SKILL_ALGORITHM single CRLF at the final line), and stripping CRLF yields the repository object byte-identically in all six cases. This is decisive evidence for the owner's ruling 1A (representation difference, no content drift) and it refutes T1R-02 finding F7, whose three-way search covered only uniform EOL transforms and therefore never entered the mixed-EOL search space where these three pins live. Protocol proposal: status DRAFT, execution_authorized false, freeze_sha256/approved_by/approved_at all UNRESOLVED, applied false; the proposed freeze recomputes exactly as sha256 of json.dumps(proposed_protocol, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True) utf-8 -> 282f52133a682e927c82b771fa103c27da34db7acbd8a12d2921f42a6d0bf36b; and the proposed protocol differs from the live contracts/protocol.json by exactly one added pointer key with zero changed values, so signing freezes the existing draft plus a decision-packet reference and nothing else. Neither contracts/protocol.json nor contracts/authority_map.json was modified (worktree bytes equal HEAD blob). The decision packet records U01-U09 and 1A/2行/3确认 faithfully against the owner-word records available (task brief, commit 945ba19fc, prior receipts' authorization_ref, open_decisions.json); U01 correctly quotes '不用担心'; the two earlier typos (Lo:p C, U01 '无上限') are absent from all seven files; the '3 wording fixes pending your nod' item maps correctly to T1R-02 F8/F9/F10 and is honestly left optional. Receipt: DELIVERED/UNREVIEWED/NOT_ENABLED, usage declares zero model/network/ssh calls with execution_chat_usage left UNRESOLVED and no counter-evidence found, write boundary confined to runs/T0/<run_id>/ across both commits, no fabricated ACCEPTED/ACTIVE/freeze anywhere (those tokens occur only in state vocabularies). Remaining findings are confined to the recording layer and none of them changes the freeze hash: F1 owner_decisions_applied lists 6 of 9 decisions without declaring its scope; F2 receipt.unresolved is an object where contracts/schemas.json requires an array; F3 summary.md labels the all-13 classification dict as the classification of the six mismatches; F5 owner_decisions_ref is a relative path among absolute ones; F6 the packet paraphrases F8/F9/F10 loosely. These are closable by the closer alongside registry/state landing and do not put the signed content or the authorization boundary at risk, so rejection or a human-adjudication hold would be disproportionate given that the owner has already ruled and the evidence now supports that ruling decisively.

flip_conditions.to_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW: if the owner wants the 6/9 owner_decisions_applied gap (F1) or the receipt schema conflict (F2) resolved in the signed artifact itself rather than in the closer's landing pass, since neither is covered by the freeze hash.
flip_conditions.to_REJECTED: if any of the recomputed load-bearing values fails on the owner's side: canonical blob ids no longer equal HEAD:<path>, the strip-CRLF identity breaks for any of the six, or the recomputed freeze hash diverges from 282f52133a682e927c82b771fa103c27da34db7acbd8a12d2921f42a6d0bf36b.

dissent: Against T1R-02 F7: the claim that pins 0653ff3d (THREADS), e35b2407 (DECISIONS) and ce0a5946 (SKILL_ALGORITHM) correspond to no repository content state is refuted by exact reconstruction from their repository blobs as mixed-EOL variants. T1R-02's proposed rewrite to '3 EOL representation + 3 unknown provenance' should not be adopted; the owner's 1A wording is correct and now proven.

Against the executor (non-blocking): protocol_proposal.owner_decisions_applied silently omits U02, U04 and U06 while claiming to record owner decisions applied; the field should either list all nine or declare that it covers only protocol-body-bearing decisions. The information survives via owner_decision_packet.md, which owner_decisions_ref points at, so this is incompleteness of a recording field, not loss or fabrication.

Against the executor (non-blocking): receipt.unresolved is an object where contracts/schemas.json $defs.receipt requires an array. The same shape appears in both T-1 receipts, so this is inherited rather than introduced here, but the T0 receipt repeats it while claiming schema=receipt.

Against the executor (non-blocking): summary.md introduces the classification dict as that of the six mismatches while printing the all-13 dict including pin_matches_worktrees:7; and owner_decisions_ref uses a relative path where every other protocol path is absolute.
Upheld from T1R-02: the substance of the package-integrity work and the refutation of T1R-01's fabrication/backfill accusation remain correct and were not disturbed by this review.

This is a proposal only. The closer owns registry/state updates and the owner owns the freeze signature and any authority_map application. No task is accepted, no protocol is frozen, no authority is rebound, and this review wrote no file.
